description: This Java class defines the model for an 'Espetáculo' (Show/Event), including its properties such as name, description, type, associated sessions, and establishment. It provides getters and setters for its fields and a placeholder method for creating sessions.

classes.name: Espetaculo
classes.description: Entity class representing a theatrical or event spectacle, with properties for identification, description, type, sessions, and venue.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: getNome
methods.description: Returns the name of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: setNome
methods.description: Sets the name of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: getDescricao
methods.description: Returns the description of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: setDescricao
methods.description: Sets the description of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: getTipo
methods.description: Returns the type of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: setTipo
methods.description: Sets the type of the Espetaculo.

methods.name: getSessoes
methods.description: Returns the list of sessions associated with this Espetaculo.

methods.name: setEstabelecimento
methods.description: Associates an Estabelecimento (venue) with this Espetaculo.

methods.name: getEstabelecimento
methods.description: Returns the Estabelecimento associated with this Espetaculo.

methods.name: criaSessoes
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to generate sessions based on start date, end date, time, and periodicity; currently returns null.
